privacidade.resumo: This app holds data about children. Below is exactly what, why, and how to erase it.

guardamos.texto: The child's nickname, the animal they picked, and their birthday if you provide one. Every allowance entry with its amount, reason and who posted it. The goals. For grown-ups: the email and name that come from the account you sign in with.

naoGuardamos.texto: No photos. No documents. No banking details. No location. The app moves no real money: the amounts are a record between you and your child.

quemVe.texto: Only the grown-ups in that family, and the child once their account is linked. One family never sees another's data, and that is enforced by the database rather than by the app alone.

quantoTempo.texto: As long as the family exists. Archiving a child keeps their history; deleting the family erases everything of theirs, permanently.

apagar.texto: On the home screen, under Delete my account. That removes your access, your name and your email. Families where you are the only member are deleted with it, along with their children and history. If you manage a family with other people, hand over management first.

terceiros.texto: The app runs on Vercel and stores data in Supabase. Signing in with Google means Google knows you use this app. There is no advertising, no tracking and no behavioural analytics.

conta.confirmarTexto: This erases your access, your name and your email. Families where you are the only member go with it, along with their children and all history. This cannot be undone.
conta.temFamilia: Hand management of your families to someone else first.
